about:
Restaurant City Providence operates a restaurant equipment and supply store in Providence, Rhode Island. The company traces its roots to over a century of industry experience, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly stated.

The business distributes commercial kitchen equipment and supplies to food-service operators. It provides project quoting, financing options, and a showroom experience known as Kitchen Campus. The Providence location serves as a sales and consultation hub; facility size, headcount, and inventory volumes are not published.

Primary customers are independent restaurants, chains, and institutional food-service operations throughout the region. The company emphasizes tailored equipment packages for new builds, remodels, and replacements.

The firm cites its 100-plus years of collective industry knowledge and a staff of equipment specialists as its core differentiator, aiming to simplify purchasing through expert guidance and flexible payment solutions.
